disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when attempting to audit .SRCINFO, resulting in an 'inconclusive' status for that file and the overall package. The other models correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: Transient API errors during file review should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if all security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .install) were successfully audited and found safe. The tool should handle partial failures gracefully, retry the failed file, or render a verdict based on the successfully audited files.
